description: Returns a picture of an artboard of the design, rendered by Paletoo itself — in the person’s open editor, else by Paletoo’s own server — to check the result. Read-only. The person does not need to open the link for a preview. Right after create_design it answers from the picture the design’s self-check already rendered.

artboard.description: an artboard id from get_design; none: every artboard, one by one

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

name: get_preview
title: See the design
